name: Wicked Games

evidence.note: Band post: annual Octoberfest Jam at Riptides, Oct 3, 7:30 pm.
Fan video from a 2024 Toomey's Tavern show; the poster praises the song selection.

dancing.notes: We could not find its song list or any description of crowds dancing at its shows.

description: Long Island cover band that plays South Shore bars and clam bars such as Riptides, Farrell's, Toomey's Tavern and Bayside Clam Bar; on Oct 3 it holds its yearly 'Octoberfest Jam' at Riptides.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Not the Bandsintown 'Wicked Games' (original pop/rock/country project) or the DC-area 'Wicked Game Band'. An Instagram 'wickedgames36' appears in search but was not verified.
